This is a partition of the existing Homework 2, with no extra questions added or removed overall. Lesson 3 reserve: Mild 9B Q4,Q7; 9E Q1,Q5(a,b). Medium 9B Q4,Q7; 9D Q4(a–h); 9E Q1,Q5(a,b),Q6(a,b).
